subject: Aligning QuantaPulse co-marketing: roadshow itinerary + MDF questions
thread_summary: Coordination between Redwood and QuantaPulse to run a 4-city tech roadshow plus a joint webinar. Key open items: MDF % split, booth staffing, cross-promotional assets, and a draft itinerary. Agreement to finalize MDF terms and sign an MOU before promotional push.
messages:
From: Aisha Shah <aisha.shah@quantapulse.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@quantapulse.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: QuantaPulse + Redwood west-coast roadshow + kickoff webinar

Hi Mina,

Great to meet on Tuesday — appreciate the quick demo. We discussed running a short west-coast roadshow (SF, LA, Seattle, Portland) in September, paired with a kickoff joint webinar the week before. QuantaPulse can cover venue deposits and half the booth build; we were hoping Redwood could lead on speaker selection and the webinar content.

A few quick Qs to get the ball rolling:
- Do you have standard MDF guidelines (percent coverage, eligible line items, reimbursement timing)?
- Any blackout dates for Redwood engineers in September?
- Would Redwood supply a co-branded slide deck and landing page?

Attaching a rough route and a sample MDF template for reference.

Cheers,
Aisha
Head of Alliances
QuantaPulse

[Attachment: Roadshow_Route_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: QuantaPulse_MDF_Terms.pdf (pdf)]

From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Shah <aisha.shah@quantapulse.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: QuantaPulse + Redwood west-coast roadshow + kickoff webinar

Hi Aisha — thanks for the note and the materials.

Ben and Marissa are looped in to review MDF and field marketing ops. Quick answers up front:
- We typically do co-op MDF at 50/50 for joint field events when there is a clear pipeline target; exceptions possible for multi-city commitments.
- Reimbursements take ~45 days after expense submission to our marketing operations team; we’ll send the expense template.
- Redwood can provide a co-branded deck and a webinar landing page (we’ll need QuantaPulse logo assets and speaker bios by July 10).

Open items we want to confirm: coverage for travel (air + hotel) for one Redwood SE per city, booth headcount expectations, and whether QuantaPulse will run local lead capture forms or we use the joint page.

We’re happy to set an MOU and a mutual action plan (MAP) to lock milestones. Proposed next step: 30-min sync next week to agree MDF %, staffing, and the webinar date. Are you available Tue 16th 10–11am PT or Wed 17th 2–3pm PT?

Thanks,
Mina
Director, Partner GTM
Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Shah <aisha.shah@quantapulse.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@quantapulse.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: QuantaPulse + Redwood west-coast roadshow + kickoff webinar

Mina — Tue 16th 10am PT works for us. Quick clarifications before the call:
- QuantaPulse can cover 60% of MDF (we budgeted aggressively for Q3) if Redwood will commit to the webinar promotional calendar and two joint sales plays targeting mid-market fintech customers.
- Travel: we can cover one SE per city for air and up to 3 nights; happy to split hotel costs.
- Lead capture: we prefer to own local forms but can feed leads into Redwood's HubSpot pipeline; need an integration point.

I’ll send an updated MDF terms PDF with our suggested changes and a proposed MAP draft prior to the call.

Best,
Aisha

[Attachment: QuantaPulse_MDF_Terms_v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Shah <aisha.shah@quantapulse.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 10:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: QuantaPulse + Redwood west-coast roadshow + kickoff webinar

Hi Aisha and team — great to meet. Notes from our sync (internal + external combined):

Summary of agreements during call:
- QuantaPulse to cover 60% MDF cap; Redwood 40% (covers booth build, local ads, and speaker travel as line items).
- Joint webinar set for Tue, 8 Sep 2026, 11am PT; webinar promo to start 3 weeks prior with joint emails and social posts.
- Roadshow tentative dates: SF 9/14, LA 9/16, Seattle 9/21, Portland 9/23.
- Redwood will provide co-branded deck, landing page, and HubSpot integration (Marissa to own).
- QuantaPulse to provide logo assets and final speaker list by 7/10.

Open action items:
- Ben to send a draft MOU (covers MDF payment schedule, lead-sharing rules, cancellation policy).
- Aisha to send updated MDF v2 with line-itemized caps and sample invoices.
- Marissa to confirm HubSpot form field mapping and GTM calendar entries by 6/25.

Attachments: Joint_Webinar_Outline.pptx (Marissa uploaded a template we’ll co-edit).

Thanks — aiming to have the MOU signed and assets shared by 7/12 so we can begin paid promo on 8/18.

—Marissa
Sr. Manager, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Joint_Webinar_Outline.pptx (pptx)]

From: Samir Rao <samir@quantapulse.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: Aisha Shah <aisha.shah@quantapulse.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: QuantaPulse + Redwood west-coast roadshow + kickoff webinar

Thanks everyone — confirming next steps on our side:
- I attached the v2 MDF PDF with line items called out and an initial estimate for each city. Please review and flag anything missing.
- We will route an internal PO to cover our MDF share once the MOU is signed.
- Q1: We also propose a short pilot joint sales play targeting 25 accounts in mid-market fintech — can Ben and Mina advise on preferred criteria?

Forwarding the MDF and a sample invoice.

Regards,
Samir
VP Partnerships
QuantaPulse
